scenarios.title: Select pair
scenarios.assertion: The selected Visualforce example and its LWC equivalent both load.

scenarios.title: Same input
scenarios.assertion: Equivalent fixture input is entered on both implementations.

scenarios.title: Same output
scenarios.assertion: The expected business result is consistent across the pair.

scenarios.title: Validation parity
scenarios.assertion: The chosen invalid input produces the specified feedback on both.

scenarios.title: Migration regression
scenarios.assertion: A disclosed change in one isolated variant is detected by the same business assertion.
